mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task (tenant_id,payment_order_no,user_id,status,revision,synced_revision,attempt_count) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{paymentOrderNo},#{userId},'PENDING',1,0,0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=VALUES(user_id),revision=revision+1, status=CASE WHEN status='SENDING' THEN status ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_retry_time=NULL,error_code=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task WHERE ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (status='SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}))) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task SET status='SENDING',lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (status='SENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task WHERE ORDER BY update_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task SET status='PENDING',revision=revision+1,attempt_count=0, next_retry_time=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} AND status='PERMANENT'

UPDATE dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task SET synced_revision=#{revision},payload_digest=#{payloadDigest}, status=CASE WHEN revision=#{revision} THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'PENDING' END, error_code=NULL,synced_time=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_time=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task SET status=CASE WHEN revision=#{revision} THEN 'RETRYABLE' ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_retry_time=CASE WHEN revision=#{revision} THEN #{nextRetryTime} ELSE NULL END, error_code=#{errorCode},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'

UPDATE dms_wechat_shipping_sync_task SET synced_revision=#{revision}, status=CASE WHEN revision=#{revision} THEN 'PERMANENT' ELSE 'PENDING' END, error_code=#{errorCode},synced_time=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_time=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='SENDING'
